patch.value: GH-930: duplicates --status all silently scans zero items
Core duplicates accepts the natural all-status sentinel as a literal status and returns a false-clean zero-item scan instead of inspecting all lifecycle states or refusing invalid input.

Core duplicates treats --status all as explicit no restriction with candidate-count parity to an omitted filter; configured status validation still rejects unknown values; structured cost and filter receipts expose the effective selection; CLI SDK contracts docs and negative tests prevent another false-clean zero-scan regression.
@unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.7 with project extensions enabled or disabled
Compare pm duplicates --status all --threshold 0.82 --limit 100 with the same command omitting --status; the former reports cost.item_count=0 while the latter reports the full tracker count.
Explicit all-status duplicate scans inspect the same complete lifecycle corpus as the unfiltered command and cannot silently degrade to zero candidates.
On 2026.8.7 explicit all reports cost.item_count=0 while omission reports the full tracker, both with exit 0.
Agents receive an exit-0 false-clean duplicate audit and can create duplicate work despite following the required all-status workflow.
